critic_dispositions.evidence: In-process Wasmtime is distinguished from unrestricted native modules; rejection is scoped to the default shared-process failure envelope.
An exchange table preserves the already discussed pipes, WIT and shared-memory tradeoffs; formats do not grant authority.
Actual host selection/revision/undo/callers/tests/update research is explicitly deferred only because no host was named.
Final explicitly includes both fuel and epochs in the blocked-host-call limitation; discovery/map already contained it.
AppContainer base/container-local file access is qualified; literal zero access is not inferred.
Final adds WMI creation, breakaway, last-handle, handle control, explicit termination and nesting conditions.
Explicit tmpfs byte/inode bounds replace an unspecified bounded private mount; cgroup memory is not a disk quota.
One-run host bytes and portal persistence/path caveats preserved; folder assurance copy is conditional on negative tests.

stop_rule: No decisive-failure early stop used. All assigned scientific originals were read completely; no additional candidate, held-out case, tree or history inspected.
reading_limits: Long tool outputs were reread in bounded portions when truncated. Embedded unchanged treatment predecessor source maps were equality-checked against the complete read originals.
